title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I know this place...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This is the cafe where Minori works. But they said this is the last spot of the tour...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come on in, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There she is. Over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Welcome, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, you're here too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. And everything is ready for the party.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, this cake looks impressive! I love the pastel colors, and it's even garnished with macarons!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We bought it to celebrate your special day! This type only just came out this month.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We got it for you because it was so pretty and we were sure you would love it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks! It looks great, and I bet it'd get a lot of likes too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? Take as many pics as you like!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I won't be holding back then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Now, how should I arrange this shot...? Maybe a close-up for extra impact, or maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is the cake okay here?
Maybe it would look better without the plates in the background.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's move them to that empty table over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okie dokie, I'll help too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if we stand here, we'll be in the picture.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, Honami, Ichika.
Can everyone hear me out for a second?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's take a photo together to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, let's have Emu, Airi and Minori in the front.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then Mizuki and Ichika behind them, and Shizuku and Honami in the third row.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What about you, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course she'd be in the center! Oh, if only I brought along a “Today's Star” sash...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I'm good without it, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey guys! Wanna do something with these party poppers?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds great! Let's all pop them at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone's got one, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've set it to selfie mode and started the timer. We've got 10 seconds!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
Ena...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How'd the photo turn out, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's perfect! You're all smiling. I'll send it to you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please do! Thanks, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you guys. The photo spot tour was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rather than just taking selfies, we switched up the perspective, got creative with our surroundings, and even took pictures of each other at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You guys all being here is what made today so amazing. And so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm incredibly grateful to you all!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what's this? Ena, you're looking a bit teary-eyed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am not...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since we've taken enough pictures of the cake, I think it's high time we dig in!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I took lots of good photos today... And the last one might just be my favorite.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank you, everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena. In all honesty, I'm not used to having my picture taken, but that didn't stop me from having as much fun as I did today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We managed to take lots of photos ourselves using your handy tips. Now we've got some good memories to hold onto forever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right, Ena♪ Y'know, there were so many other wonderhoy photo spots I wanted to show you at the park! So I hope you'll come visit again☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika and Honami mentioned that it's your birthday.
I was really inspired by what you said at the goldfish exhibit. You have your art, and I have the bass... We're working on different things, but let's both give it our all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena. To think that we'd bump into each other like that! How was the photo tour?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since that's all she talked about at dinner that night, I'm guessing she had a blast.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. It was thanks to that tour that we were able to wish you a happy birthday in person, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'd like for us to show you around Vivid Street next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Now that's where I draw the line.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena! I'm so glad we got to celebrate your birthday with a cake from our cafe. The manager is really proud of that one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, and Mizuki and I were really proud of our tour idea. I couldn't be happier that you enjoyed it so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Ena looked like she was having so much fun at the cafe, and I noticed you both watching her and smiling too! You all looked so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey, don't say stuff like that, it's embarrassing!
Ahem. Once again, happy birthday, Ena. We're gonna be friends forever!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ena. I heard about the photo tour from Hoshino and Hanasato. It sounds like you had a lot of fun.
Thanks for all the wonderful illustrations. Looking forward to another year with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday. Spending time with you makes me feel a bit more at ease... I think.
Anyway, I'll see you later on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wasn't the photo tour just the best?! Seeing you have so much fun told me that was a job well done on my part. Happy birthday, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The photo tour sure was a lot of fun. I'm surprised that everyone managed to plan all this while juggling their busy schedules...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone did so much to celebrate for me, so starting tomorrow—no, today—I'll be raising the bar.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh! Maybe I should capture the events of today in a sketch. The practice will do me some good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I've got this!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you so much for today, everyone. I'll see you again soon.
